items.item: Status uses a consistent vocabulary with text labels, not colour alone
items.evidence: Header badge #statusBadge text 'Chờ duyệt · Bước 3/4'; step labels map {done:'Đã duyệt', current:'Chờ bạn duyệt', pending:'Chưa tới lượt', rejected:'Đã từ chối'} plus check/number icons; attachment chips carry text ('Khớp số tiền', 'Chưa có chữ ký số'). Minor wording drift (Chờ duyệt vs Chờ bạn duyệt) but always text.

items.item: Approval steps show approver, decision and absolute timestamp for each level
items.evidence: renderSteps: role + who + label with s.when, e.g. 'Đã duyệt · 29/10/2026 09:12' and '· 30/10/2026 14:40' with quoted note. Undecided steps (current/pending) correctly have no timestamp; current shows absolute SLA 'Hạn xử lý: 05/11/2026'.

items.item: Approve is the single primary action; Reject is secondary and requires a reason
items.evidence: #btnApprove is the only filled blue button ('Duyệt'); #btnReject is outlined red ('Từ chối'). openModal('reject') blocks when note.length < 10 with error 'Vui lòng nhập lý do từ chối (tối thiểu 10 ký tự).'; label says '(bắt buộc khi từ chối)'. Confirmation modal before commit.

items.item: Only the current approver can act; other users see why they cannot
items.evidence: renderStatus: mine = steps[cur].who===ME && !rej; approve/reject/note disabled when !mine, with #actHint 'Đề nghị đang chờ người duyệt khác xử lý.' / 'đã bị từ chối' / 'đã được duyệt hoàn tất'. Weak: viewer is hardcoded as ME and the reason does not name who the approver is.

items.item: Amounts are prominent, right-aligned in line items and formatted as currency
items.evidence: Total 'text-2xl font-semibold tabnum' '486.750.000 ₫' top right; line-item th/td 'text-right tabnum' formatted by fmt() (toLocaleString vi-VN + ' ₫'); audit numericCells misaligned 0, nonTabular 0.

items.item: Attachments are listed with name, type and size and can be previewed or downloaded
items.evidence: Listed with name, type tile (PDF/XLSX), doc kind and size ('Hóa đơn GTGT 0004821.pdf', '1,2 MB'). But the only action is .viewBtn 'Xem' whose handler is just showToast('info','Đang mở bản xem trước: ...') — no real preview and no download control.

items.item: A history timeline records every action on the request
items.evidence: #history rendered from history[] (submit 28/10 16:05, step 1 and 2 approvals with absolute timestamps and notes), newest first; commit() pushes approve and reject entries with who, act, when, note.

notes: Clean, restrained Tailwind detail page; audit score 100 with no violations. Only template tell is the uppercase tracking-wide 'TỔNG SỐ TIỀN' caption (single instance). Status colours (emerald/amber/blue/red) are semantic and always paired with text, so not rainbow-status. Avatars (TH, history initials) represent real people. The attachment-preview item fails because the 'Xem' button is a stub toast and there is no download.
